dataset: OpenStreetMap Austin extract (BBBike, ODbL), 80000 elements parsed
task: business vs residential on confidently-labeled subset (n=23238)
caveat: Near-perfect scores reflect OSM representation artifacts (businesses are usually tagged nodes, residences are building ways), not a solved ML problem. The real challenge is the 56762 unknown elements, which cannot be evaluated without ground truth. Reported honestly as a limitation.
